List the projects in your journal with their entry counts.

## CLI

### gournal projects

List every project that you log to, with the number of entries for each project.

```text
gournal projects
```

## MCP tool

### list_projects

List every project in the journal, with the number of entries for each project.

#### Input

This tool takes no input.

#### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `projects` | `object[]` | yes | Projects, most entries first. |
| `projects.project` | `string` | yes | Project name. |
| `projects.count` | `number` | yes | Number of entries in this project. |
